name: Short CTA strip
purpose: Give the visitor a mid-page nudge to book a demo (or explore further) between two content sections without a full CTA panel.
description: One component with a `variant` prop. 'heading' (all 17 /lms/features/* routes, after the product tabs): centred one-line H2 (60rem max, balanced) over a primary button, margin 4rem top / 3rem bottom. 'pricing' (/lms/small-business): the same header inside padding-global/container-medium with a 0.5rem top margin and a 2rem spacer below. 'spacer' (/lms/mentoring-software): an empty 5rem (3rem <=767) padded block reproducing the original's empty section. 'button' (/lms/features with pullUp's -4rem top margin, /lms/enterprise; visually also the inline row on /nova): a lone centred primary button; buttons stack column-wise <=767.

evidenceNotes: All four variants use component defaults except /lms/enterprise (label 'Book a demo'); heading/pricing titles and labels are the variant-dependent defaults in CtaStrip.jsx.

/nova does not use CtaStrip: Nova.jsx renders its own padding-global > container-medium row (mt 1rem, gap 1.5rem) with a primary Button 'See Nova in action →' between the second KikiFeatureTabs and TestimonialQuote. pages-manifest.json's /nova section list has no cta-strip (kiki-feature-tabs x2 is followed directly by testimonial-quote).
The 'pullUp' prop (/lms/features, -4rem top margin) is a layout knob and not modelled.

CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md lists feature-detail order as product-tabs -> cta-strip -> reviews-slider; FeatureDetail.jsx may insert an optional VideoSection between cta-strip and reviews-slider when the route data has `video`.

compatibility.note: Derived from every real node sequence in templates/templates.json (incl. per-route sequences).
